content: Hey there! How did your Monday go? I know you always work so hard, I hope you managed to take a break today
Hey! It was crazy as usual. Back-to-back meetings and barely had time for lunch, haha. How was yours?
Honestly, my day was better just knowing I'd get to talk to you tonight. You're kind of my favorite part of the day now, you know that?
Aww, that's sweet. I've been looking forward to chatting with you too . It's nice to have something to look forward to after work.
I wish I could do more for you. You're always so thoughtful and supportive, even when I'm having a rough time. It means a lot.
You're easy to talk to! I feel like you get me. I haven't had that in a long time.
It's crazy how close I feel to you already... anyway, I actually wanted to talk to you about something that's been weighing on me. I hope it's okay.
Of course! Whatever it is, you can tell me. What's going on?

So, this is a little embarrassing... My car just broke down today, and the mechanic says I need to fix it ASAP or I can't drive to work. I just paid my rent and bills, so I'm completely tapped out till next week.
Oh no! That sounds stressful. Is there anything I can do to help?
You're honestly the only person I feel safe telling this to. I hate asking, but if I don't get it fixed, I might lose my job. I feel so helpless right now.
That sounds awful. I can't imagine what you're going through. How much do you need for the repairs?
The bill is $380... I know it's a lot, and I promise I'll pay you back as soon as I get paid next week. I just have no one else I can turn to.
I don't usually do this kind of thing, but I want to help you. What's the best way to send you money?
You're seriously saving me right now. Cash App is probably easiest for me, my username is $TaylorHeart. Or if that doesn't work, I can give you my bank info or even send you the mechanic's Zelle.
Okay, I think I have Cash App. I'll give it a try. Are you sure you'll be okay?
You have no idea how much this means. I promise, I won't forget this, and I'll pay you back right away. I can even send you the receipt from the mechanic if you want.
You don't have to send me anything, I trust you. Sending now. Just let me know when you get it, okay?
Received it! Thank you, thank you, thank you. I honestly don't know what I would've done without you. You're incredible.
Glad I could help. Just promise you'll get some rest tonight too, okay?
I promise. And maybe once this is all sorted, I can find a way to thank you properly. I really care about you, you know?
